linkedin_version:
Your Tax Timing Is Now Part of Your Lending Story

For SME borrowers, BAS, PAYG, ATO debt, and Payday Super timing are not just admin. They are evidence of whether the business can keep a clean cash-flow rhythm while asking a lender for money.

Here's what most business owners miss:

Commercial lenders don't just assess profit and loss. They read payment timing patterns as signals of financial discipline and cash-flow predictability.

**The new reality (post-Payday Super, July 2026):**
- Super is now paid with payroll (not quarterly)
- Cash-flow rhythm has changed
- Lenders are adjusting their assessment models
- Your tax timing tells a story about your business health

**What gets assessed:**
✓ BAS lodgement and payment timing
✓ PAYG withholding patterns
✓ ATO debt status and payment plans
✓ Payday Super compliance and timing

Late or irregular patterns signal financial stress — even if your P&L looks strong.

**Before you apply for commercial lending, know where you stand.**

Our Commercial Financial Health Check shows you the same signals lenders see — in 4 minutes, with no credit check.

[Get your Commercial FHC](https://fhc.oneyco.com.au/commercial)
